description: The session's commit log, newest first — the ids `session_revert`/`session_restore` take. Each entry carries a description, who wrote it (unattributed when nothing recorded that), and a timestamp, in the order the changes happened. Reach for it when the session predates your context, or to see whether things changed mid-task (commits you did not write, and where they fall among yours).

limit.description: Maximum entries to return, newest first (default 20).

session_id.description: Target session id, from `info` or `list_sessions`. Required.

name: list_commits
